Plating buildup on a ±0.02 mm feature can push it out of tolerance and cause assembly interference; the designer should add a note or adjust the tolerance to explicitly allow for the coating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a note stating that dimensions are before plating (or after, as intended), or reduce the nominal size / widen the tolerance on D6 to accommodate the specified I.Z.B.P. plating thickness."}]}
